high_level_description: This image is the cover of an issue of Empire magazine, dated January 2026. The cover features a dramatic and intense scene with a large, mythical creature emerging from the water, partially submerged, with its head and upper body visible. The creature appears to be a dragon or a similar fantastical being, with scales and a fierce expression. In the foreground, there is a man dressed in ancient Roman or Greek armor, standing in the water with his back to the viewer.
